description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Sephiroth)] and [Fire Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Sephiroth)
description.text: Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 2 additional times, grants [100% Critical 4]/[Deadly Strikes +20% 4] if the user's critical hit chance is 0-99%/100% after the first Fire ability used in this mode, grants [Fire Ability Quick Cast 4] after the first Fire ability used in this mode

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Fire Mode II (Sephiroth)], removes [Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Sephiroth)]
